summary: Executed backend+frontend validation for admin auction dashboard parity, admin auction lifecycle APIs, auth playbook checks, and customer auction regression using public preview URL.

critical.issue: Allows creating auctions for inactive products (expected validation reject).

minor.issue: access-control-allow-origin header was missing in test response while access-control-allow-credentials=true was present; likely preview ingress/proxy header behavior but should be validated end-to-end.

ui_bugs.component: AdminAuctionDashboard auction cards / ending soon list
ui_bugs.issue: Auction images render broken/blank because UI reads auction.product.image while backend product payload provides images[] array.
Search result ordering not stable during filtering; observed mismatch between expected filtered order and rendered order.

integration_issues.issue: Bid click returned 409 in-console (auction became non-live), but UI handled gracefully with message and no crash.

issues: Key informational blocks (Ending soon rows, Recent bids rows, summary/revenue blocks) lack dedicated data-testid hooks despite testability guideline for key info elements.

action_items: Backend: enforce product eligibility in POST /api/admin/auctions (active=true and stock>0) before creating auction.
Frontend: replace auction.product.image usage with auction.product.images?.[0] in AdminAuctionDashboard card + ending list renders.
Frontend: make admin auction search deterministic (preserve source order while filtering under live refresh or debounce/hold refresh while query active).
Frontend: add data-testid for ending-soon items, recent-bid items, auction summary panel, and revenue panel for robust automation.
Infra/App validation: confirm CORS allow-origin propagation through preview ingress for auth routes when Origin header is present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_auction validates product existence but not product active/stock state, enabling auctions on inactive inventory.
AdminAuctionDashboard polls every second and performs N+1 bid-history calls (up to 24 extra requests per tick), increasing race conditions and UI reorder jitter.
AdminAuctionDashboard references product.image while Product schema and API payload use images list, causing broken image rendering.

success_rate.frontend: 78% (core dashboard and modal flows passed; search-order and image rendering issues found)

seed_data_creation: Created disposable TEST products and auctions via admin API, placed test bids via customer session, and closed/soft-deactivated test entities during cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin route was reachable using API-authenticated browser session (cookie-based workaround), so login redirect flakiness from prior run was not blocking this iteration. Preserve this approach if preview login intermittently sticks.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: Inactive product auction creation reproduced by creating active=false product then POST /api/admin/auctions; endpoint returned 201 because server only checks product_id existence. RCA-2: Admin auction card images blank due to UI field mismatch (expects product.image, backend sends product.images[]). RCA-3: Search ordering instability likely from 1-second live refresh + repeated data reload while query is active, causing list mutation during filter rendering.
